meta.summary: Overview of all chapters and appendices of the package with audience, owner, and recommended level by company size.

title: Chapter list
summary: The package has 24 chapters in seven pillars and six appendices. The table below states for each chapter who it is intended for, who owns it in the company, and which level a small (S, up to 100 users), medium-sized (M, up to 1,000), and large (L, above 1,000) company should target. The Assessment column lists the questions of the maturity questionnaire that measure the chapter.

sections.title: How to read the list
sections.html:
How to read the list

Levels: Basic is the necessary minimum, Standard written rules with regular reviews and partial automation, Advanced full automation and measurement. A dash means that the chapter can be omitted for that size. The Trust pillar (GOV-09 to GOV-12) always targets at least Standard.

Pillars: Foundation (who decides and on what basis), Structure (how the tenant is organized), Trust (access, sharing, protection, retention), Experience (search, branding, editorial, customization), Value (Copilot, measurement), Operations (monitoring, recovery, incidents, changes), People (adoption and support).
